extraction: santa-method requires two independent adversarial reviewers to pass before output ships. Reviewer 1: checks mechanism correctness (does code match spec?). Reviewer 2: checks outcome validity (does output meet quality bar?). Both must APPROVE. Maps to our validation call: Engine output → Verdict (reviewer 1) → Miss applies fixes → Verdict re-verifies (reviewer 2). Our 3-agent model IS santa-method with Verdict as dual reviewer.
